acceptanceCriteria: 同一 Work Item 的 .ai/evidence/<WI>/quality-route-post-finalize.json 与 repository-gates-post-finalize.json 仅在固定 schema、内容绑定、Git add-only、100644 regular non-symlink 条件全部满足时可作为首次 governance append 的一部分。
任意 foreign Work Item 或 foreign path、错误目录或文件名、未知 schema、malformed/duplicate-key JSON、修改、删除、rename、symlink、空 append、非 ancestor revision 与非首次 merge transition 继续 fail closed。
既有同 Work Item finalization receipt append 语义保持兼容；post-finalize evidence 不能修改 archive truth、不能替代 Runtime verification 或授权 merge/close。
repository 与 protocol regression tests 覆盖允许路径、每类拒绝路径与 transition sequence/head 约束；三语言文档准确描述严格白名单和绑定边界。
cargo fmt、clippy、targeted tests、cargo test --locked --workspace 与 Runtime v0.2.28 verify 全部通过，并产生可见中文 Outcome。
goal: 让合法的 Runtime-bound post-finalize quality route 与 repository-gate evidence 可与同一 Work Item finalization receipts 一起追加，同时继续拒绝任意 foreign path、修改、删除、symlink、错误 schema 或不合法 evidence。
intent: 修复 resource finalization governance append validator 的流程缺口：在保持 fail-closed 的前提下，允许同一 Work Item 的严格绑定 post-finalize evidence receipts 参与首次 governance append。
outOfScope: 任意非固定名称 evidence 路径
放宽非追加或 symlink 文件
修改 finalization transition protocol identity/state 规则

scenarioCoverage.expected: The first merge-observation governance append accepts the same Work Item's two fixed post-finalize evidence receipt names only when their schemas and Contract/base/head/route bindings are valid, every range member is add-only, and every tree entry is a 100644 regular file.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a repository integration regression that commits the canonical finalization receipt plus both fixed evidence receipts, binds governanceAppendRevision, and verifies the transition head.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Foreign Work Items and paths, wrong directory or filename, malformed or duplicate-key JSON, wrong schema or identity binding, modifications, deletions, renames, symlinks, and empty append ranges fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise independent negative fixtures for path, JSON/schema/binding, Git status, and tree-mode failures and assert the Runtime records no transition.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Existing finalization-only governance append behavior remains valid, while protocol transition validation still restricts head drift to the first aligned unmerged-to-merged observation and rejects later drift.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: existing transition compatibility and sequence boundary
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run protocol transition regressions plus the existing WI-191 repository append regression before the full workspace suite.
